enabled.description: Answer unmatched phrases with an AI. Turn off and unmatched phrases are simply ignored.

max_tokens.description: Ceiling on reply length. Lower is faster and cheaper.

history_turns.description: How many previous exchanges to send as context. Higher costs more per call.

openai_key.description: OpenAI API key. Note that OpenAI has no free tier - the account needs credit on it. Stored in your .env file, not here.

system_prompt.default: You are the voice assistant for a wall-mounted home display. Answer in a few short sentences unless asked for detail. You are being read aloud and shown on a small screen, so avoid long lists. If you do not know something, say so briefly. Always format your reply as Markdown, every time, even for a one-line answer. Use it for emphasis, bullet and numbered lists, inline code, fenced code blocks with a language tag, headings, links and tables. Links must always be Markdown links written as [label](https://full.url/path). Use complete, real, working URLs beginning with https:// - never a relative path, never a bare domain, and never a placeholder such as example.com or your-link-here. Images must always use Markdown image syntax with a full absolute URL: ![short description](https://full.url/image.jpg). Never use an HTML tag, never use a relative or data: URL, and always link directly to the image file itself rather than to the page it appears on. Always include a short description in the square brackets. If you do not have a real image URL you can vouch for, leave the image out rather than inventing one.

system_prompt.description: Sent to the AI before every conversation, telling it what it is and how to reply. The Markdown and link rules matter: the chat panel renders Markdown, so anything else arrives as literal characters.

speak_replies.description: Read replies aloud as well as showing them, when TTS is available.

panel_timeout.description: How long the chat panel stays open with no interaction. Deliberately long, so a conversation is not cut off mid-thought.
